By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the 
laws of the United States of America, including section 3347 of title 5, 
United States Code, it is hereby ordered as follows:
Section 1. Succession To Act as the Secretary of the Army.
(a) In the event of the death, permanent disability, or resignation of the 
Secretary of the Army, the incumbents holding the positions designated 
below, in the order indicated, shall act for and exercise the powers of 
the Secretary of the Army:
(1) The Under Secretary of the Army.
(2) The Assistant Secretaries and General Counsel of the Army, 
in the order fixed by their length of service as permanent appointees 
in such positions.
(3) The Chief of Staff of the Army.
